query: within-run and across-run adaptation agent training
text:
1. **PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents** — The closest match: combines within-run “live steering” with persistent skills and memory reused across later runs. People: Yang Xiao, Yusong Sun, Haoyi Wu, Wenyang Hui, Wen Da, Zhaokai Luo, Mu Chuan, Yao Hu, Wenjie Li, Chengyue Jiang. Affiliation: **AllSpark Team**. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26530)

2. **Continual Harness: Online Adaptation for Self-Improving Foundation Agents** — Adapts prompts, subagents, skills, and memory during a continuous run, then uses trajectories for model–harness co-training. People: Seth Karten, Joel Zhang, Tersoo Upaa Jr., Ruirong Feng, Wenzhe Li, Chengshuai Shi, Chi Jin, Kiran Vodrahalli. Affiliations: **Princeton University, ARISE Foundation, Google DeepMind**. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09998)

3. **Agentic Context Engineering: Evolving Contexts for Self-Improving Language Models (ACE)** — Maintains an evolving playbook that supports both online agent-memory adaptation and offline context optimization across runs. People: Qizheng Zhang, Changran Hu, Shubhangi Upasani, Boyuan Ma, Fenglu Hong, Vamsidhar Kamanuru, Jay Rainton, Chen Wu, Mengmeng Ji, Hanchen Li, Urmish Thakker, James Zou, Kunle Olukotun. Affiliations: **Stanford University, SambaNova Systems, UC Berkeley**. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04618)

4. **CLIN: A Continually Learning Language Agent for Rapid Task Adaptation and Generalization** — Uses persistent causal memory to improve over trials and constructs meta-memory for transfer across episodes, environments, and tasks. People: Bodhisattwa Prasad Majumder, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra, Peter Jansen, Oyvind Tafjord, Niket Tandon, Li Zhang, Chris Callison-Burch, Peter Clark. Affiliations: **Allen Institute for AI, University of Arizona, University of Pennsylvania**. [Project page](https://allenai.github.io/clin/)

5. **Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning** — A foundational approach in which agents reflect during iterative attempts and preserve those reflections as episodic memory for subsequent trials. People: Noah Shinn, Federico Cassano, Ashwin Gopinath, Karthik Narasimhan, Shunyu Yao. Affiliations: **Northeastern University, MIT, Princeton University**. [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=vAElhFcKW6)

1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — Min Cai and Xi Ye (University of Alberta/Amii); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (independent). Preprint, October 2026. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **SEAL: Synergistic Co-Evolution of Agents and Learning Environments** — Yihao Hu, Zhihao Wen, Xiujin Liu, Pan Wang, Xin Zhang, and Wei Wu; affiliations represented include Ant Group, Westlake University, University of Michigan–Ann Arbor, and University of Science and Technology of China. Preprint, May 2026. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24426)

3. **Agent-World: Scaling Real-World Environment Synthesis for Evolving General Agent Intelligence** — Guanting Dong, Junting Lu, Junjie Huang, Wanjun Zhong, Longxiang Liu, Shijue Huang, Zhenyu Li, Yang Zhao, Xiaoshuai Song, Xiaoxi Li, Jiajie Jin, Yutao Zhu, Hanbin Wang, Fangyu Lei, Qinyu Luo, Mingyang Chen, Zehui Chen, Jiazhan Feng, Ji-Rong Wen, and Zhicheng Dou; Renmin University of China and ByteDance Seed. Preprint, April 2026. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18292)

4. **CoEvolve: Training LLM Agents via Agent-Data Mutual Evolution** — Shidong Yang, Ziyu Ma, Tongwen Huang, Yiming Hu, Yong Wang, and Xiangxiang Chu; AMAP, Alibaba Group. Published at ACL 2026. [ACL Anthology](https://aclanthology.org/2026.acl-long.1055/)

5. **COvolve: Adversarial Co-Evolution of LLM-Generated Policies and Environments via Two-Player Zero-Sum Game** — Alkis Sygkounas, Rishi Hazra, Andreas Persson, Pedro Zuidberg Dos Martires, and Amy Loutfi; Machine Perception and Interaction Lab, Örebro University, Sweden. GECCO 2026. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.28386)
